name: Variation Gallery for WooCommerce
author: TaskPlugins

sections.description:
Variation Gallery for WooCommerce allows you to customize where variation thumbnail galleries appear relative to the product gallery. By default, WooCommerce allows multiple images for each variation, which has no limits on how much visual information can be shown.

👉 Plugin Demo | Documentation | Get Pro 👈

Core Features & Highlights

✨ Image slider: Uses Slick Slider for smooth, responsive navigation of the main product gallery image.

✨ Thumbnail position (Top/ Bottom): Offers flexible positioning for product gallery thumbnails with options to align them on the top or bottom.

✨ Thumbnail slider: Uses Slick Slider for smooth, responsive navigation of the main product thumbnail image.

✨ Zoom option: Enables a zoom feature on main product images, allowing detailed viewing across all color and style variations.

✨ Light box: Enables a lightbox popup for viewing product variation and main gallery images in a full-screen, high-resolution display.

✨ Global & Product-Level Controls: Configure settings globally via WordPress Admin → Tools → Variation Gallery or customize them per product under the product editor tab.

How to Work Settings with Gallery.

✨ Thumbnail Position Top: Displays gallery thumbnails above the main product image.

👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position Bottom: Displays gallery thumbnails below the main image (Default).

👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position Left (Pro): Displays gallery thumbnails stacked vertically on the left side.

👉 Live Demo | Documentation

✨ Thumbnail Position Right (Pro): Displays gallery thumbnails stacked vertically on the right side.

👉 Live Demo | Documentation

Compatibility

Variation Gallery for Woocommerce plugin is integrated into WooCommerce and WordPress, but only where necessary. It’s unlikely to conflict with other plugins.

Need Any Help?

👉 For any bug, support or suggestion please submit your ticket here .
sections.installation:
1. Upload the variation gallery for woocommerce folder to your /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen.
  3. Navigate WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Variation Gallery to set the variation gallery settings.
  4. Go to WooCommerce product to Add New Products or Edit Product.
sections.faq:
How to Use WooCommerce Variation Gallery

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Tools → Variation & Gallery

Is it compatible with any kinds of WooCommerce Theme?

Yes, it is compatible with Most popular WooCommerce themes , but need some css update.

How do I add multiple images to a product variation?

By default, WooCommerce allows multiple gallery images for each specific product variation:

  • Navigate to WordPress Admin Panel → Products and edit a variable product.
  • Select the Variations tab and open a variation accordion box.
  • Add your desired images for that specific variation and save the changes.

How do I configure gallery settings for an individual product?

If you want to customize gallery behavior for a single product without enforcing global rules.

  • Go to Products → Variable Product in your WordPress dashboard.
  • Click on the Variation Gallery tab located inside the Product Data panel.
  • Select your preferred thumbnail position checkbox and click Save Changes.

How do I configure global settings across my entire store?

You can set default global rules that apply to all variable products.

  • Go to WordPress Admin Panel → Variation Gallery → Settings.
  • If you want these global rules to supersede individual product options, enable the Override Product Settings option.
  • Choose your desired thumbnail position settings and click Save Settings.
